params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 physical copies reportedly arriving with missing or used codes Some players who bought GTA 6 on disc say their boxes came with download codes that are missing or were already redeemed. The reports have left a number of buyers angry just as copies start reaching people. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 20:19 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @RockstarGames 😤 Got your copy yet? React and tell us in the comments if your code worked #GTA6 #RockstarGames #PS5 #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
